footer.tagline: Shahrnama, smart QR-based cultural tourism for Kermanshah

home.title: Every stone has a story. Just scan.
home.description: Scan the QR code beside historical sites across Kermanshah, from Taq-e Bostan to Bisotun, and read each place's history, images, and narrative on the spot.

how.title: History in three steps, no app needed
how.body: Scan the QR plaque beside a site. Its story opens in your browser.

HISTORICAL.title: From Bisotun to Taq-e Bostan
HISTORICAL.body: Reliefs, tekyehs, and mosques. Older layers of the city and region.

HANDICRAFT.title: Made in the bazaar
HANDICRAFT.body: Giveh, kilims, carpets, and souvenirs still crafted in local workshops.

STREET.title: Streets that shape the city
STREET.body: Axes and facades that stitch Kermanshah's urban fabric together.

LANDMARK.title: Everyday orientation points
LANDMARK.body: Squares, parks, and places every passerby knows how to find.

FOOD.title: Taste a Creative City of Gastronomy
FOOD.body: From dandeh kebab to bread and ash. Signature dishes of Kermanshah.
